title.raw: 卷一百四十 志第九十三 樂十五 Volume 140 Treatises 93: Music 15

sentences.zh: 樂十五

translations.literal: Music Fifteen
translations.idiomatic: Music 15

sentences.zh: （鼓吹上）〉

translations.literal: (Acclamations, Upper Section)
translations.idiomatic: (Acclamations, Upper Section)

sentences.zh: 鼓吹者，軍樂也。

translations.literal: Acclamations are military music.
translations.idiomatic: Acclamations are military music.

sentences.zh: 昔黃帝涿鹿有功，命岐伯作凱歌，以建威武、揚德風、厲士諷敵。

translations.literal: In antiquity, when the Yellow Emperor achieved merit at Zhuolu, he ordered Qibo to compose triumphant songs to display martial authority, spread virtuous influence, encourage the soldiers, and satirize the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, after the Yellow Emperor won merit at Zhuolu, he ordered Qibo to compose triumphant songs to display martial prowess, spread virtuous influence, steel the troops, and mock the enemy.

sentences.zh: 其曲有《靈夔競》、《雕鶚爭》、《石墜崖》、《壯士怒》之名，《周官》所謂“師有功則凱歌”者也。

translations.literal: The pieces were named "Spirit Kui Contends," "Eagle and Kite Struggle," "Stone Falls from the Cliff," and "Hero's Wrath"—what the Offices of Zhou calls "when the army achieves merit, then play triumphant songs."
translations.idiomatic: Among their titles were Spirit Kui Contends, Eagle and Kite Struggle, Stone Falls from the Cliff, and The Hero's Wrath—what the Offices of Zhou means by "when the army achieves merit, then play triumphant songs."

sentences.zh: 漢有《朱鷺》等十八曲，短簫鐃歌序戰伐之事，黃門鼓吹為享宴所用，又有騎吹二曲。

translations.literal: Han had eighteen pieces such as Vermilion Heron; short xiao and nao songs narrated campaigns and battles; Yellow Gate Acclamations were used at banquets; there were also two mounted-blow pieces.
translations.idiomatic: The Han had eighteen pieces such as Vermilion Heron. Short xiao and nao songs recounted campaigns and battles; Yellow Gate Acclamations served at banquets; and there were also two mounted-blow pieces.

sentences.zh: 說者謂列於殿庭者為鼓吹，從行者為騎吹。

translations.literal: Commentators say those arrayed in the palace hall are acclamations; those accompanying the procession on the move are mounted-blow.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators hold that pieces arrayed in the palace hall are acclamations, while those accompanying a procession on the move are mounted-blow.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉而下，莫不沿尚，始有鼓吹之名。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin downward, none failed to follow and esteem them, and only then did the name acclamations arise.
translations.idiomatic: From the Wei and Jin periods onward, every dynasty followed this practice, and only then did the name acclamations become fixed.

sentences.zh: 江左太常有鼓吹之樂，梁用十二曲，陳二十四曲，後周亦十五曲。

translations.literal: The Eastern Jin Grand Music Office had acclamation music; Liang used twelve pieces, Chen twenty-four, and Later Zhou also fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Jin Grand Music Office maintained acclamation music; Liang used twelve pieces, Chen twenty-four, and Later Zhou fifteen as well.

sentences.zh: 唐製，大駕、法駕、小駕及一品而下皆有焉。

translations.literal: Under Tang regulations, the grand carriage, regulated carriage, minor carriage, and ranks from first grade downward all had them.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang regulations, the grand carriage, regulated carriage, minor carriage, and all ranks from first grade downward were each provided with them.

sentences.zh: 宋初因之，車駕前後部用金鉦、節鼓、鼓、大鼓、小鼓、鐃鼓、羽葆鼓、中鳴、大橫吹、小橫吹、觱栗、桃皮觱栗、簫、笳、笛，歌《導引》一曲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song they followed this; the front and rear sections of the imperial train used golden gongs, marking drums, tao drums, large and small drums, nao drums, plumed-banner drums, mid-clarinets, large and small transverse flutes, suona, peach-skin suona, xiao, jia, and di, singing one piece, Guiding Procession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Song they followed this practice. The front and rear sections of the imperial train employed golden gongs, marking drums, tao drums, large and small drums, nao drums, plumed-banner drums, mid-clarinets, large and small transverse flutes, suona, peach-skin suona, xiao, jia, and di, and sang one piece, Guiding Procession.

sentences.zh: 又皇太子及一品至三品，皆有本品鼓吹。

translations.literal: Also the crown prince and ranks from first through third grade each had acclamations of their respective grade.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and officials from first through third grade were each likewise granted acclamations appropriate to their rank.

sentences.zh: 凡大駕用一千五百三十人為五引，司徒六十四人，開封牧、太常卿、御史大夫、兵部尚書各二十三人。

translations.literal: In all, the grand carriage used 1,530 men in five processional sections; the Minister over the Masses had 64; the Kaifeng governor, Grand Music Director, Censor-in-Chief, and Minister of War each had 23.
translations.idiomatic: In all, the grand carriage employed 1,530 men in five processional sections. The Minister over the Masses had 64; the Kaifeng governor, Grand Music Director, Censor-in-Chief, and Minister of War each had 23.

sentences.zh: 法駕三分減一，用七百六十一人為二引，開封牧、御史大夫各一十六人。

translations.literal: The regulated carriage reduced by one-third, using 761 men in two sections; the Kaifeng governor and Censor-in-Chief each had 16.
translations.idiomatic: The regulated carriage reduced the complement by one-third, using 761 men in two sections; the Kaifeng governor and Censor-in-Chief each had 16.

sentences.zh: 小駕用八百一十六人。

translations.literal: The minor carriage used 816 men.
translations.idiomatic: The minor carriage used 816 men.

sentences.zh: 太常鼓吹署樂工數少，每大禮，皆取之於諸軍。

translations.literal: The Grand Music Office's Acclamations Bureau had few musicians; at every great ceremony they were all drawn from the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Acclamations Bureau of the Grand Music Office had too few musicians, so at every great ceremony they were all drawn from the various armies.

sentences.zh: 一品已下喪葬則給之，亦取於諸軍。

translations.literal: For funerals of first grade and below they were granted, also taken from the armies.
translations.idiomatic: For funerals of officials from first grade downward, acclamations were likewise granted, again drawn from the armies.

sentences.zh: 又大禮，車駕宿齋所止，夜設警場，用一千二百七十五人。

translations.literal: Also at great ceremonies, where the imperial train lodged for fasting, a night watch ground was set up, using 1,275 men.
translations.idiomatic: At great ceremonies, wherever the imperial train lodged for the fasting vigil, a night watch ground was established, employing 1,275 men.

sentences.zh: 奏嚴用金鉦、大角、大鼓，樂用大小橫吹、觱栗、簫、笳、笛，角手取於近畿諸州，樂工亦取於軍中，或追府縣樂工備數。

translations.literal: For performing the vigil they used golden gongs, great horns, and great drums; music used large and small transverse flutes, suona, xiao, jia, and di; horn players were taken from nearby prefectures, musicians also from the armies, or county and prefectural musicians were summoned to fill the quota.
translations.idiomatic: The vigil was performed with golden gongs, great horns, and great drums; the music used large and small transverse flutes, suona, xiao, jia, and di. Horn players were drawn from prefectures near the capital, musicians from the armies, or prefectural and county musicians were summoned to make up the numbers.

sentences.zh: 歌《六州》、《十二時》，每更三奏之。

translations.literal: They sang Six Prefectures and Twelve Hours, performing each three times at every watch.
translations.idiomatic: They sang Six Prefectures and Twelve Hours, performing each piece three times at every watch.

sentences.zh: （大中祥符六年，以其煩擾，詔罷追集，悉以禁兵充，常隸太常閱集。

translations.literal: (In the sixth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, because it was burdensome and disruptive, an edict abolished summoning musicians from afar; all were filled by palace guards, regularly subordinate to the Grand Music Office for review and assembly.
translations.idiomatic: (In the sixth year of Dazhong Xiangfu [1013], because the practice was burdensome and disruptive, an edict ended the summoning of musicians from afar; palace guards filled all posts and were regularly assigned to the Grand Music Office for review and assembly.

sentences.zh: 七年，親享太廟，登歌始作，聞廟外奏嚴，遂詔：行禮之次，權罷嚴警；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, as the ascent hymn began, the vigil music outside the temple was heard; thereupon an edict said: during the rites, temporarily suspend the vigil guard;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year [1014], when the emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the ascent hymn had just begun when vigil music was heard outside the temple. An edict then ordered that during the rites the vigil guard be temporarily suspended;

sentences.zh: 禮畢，仍復故。）〉

translations.literal: when the rites were finished, restore the former practice.)
translations.idiomatic: and when the rites were finished, the former practice was to be restored.)

sentences.zh: 凡祀前一日，上御青城門觀奏嚴。

translations.literal: On the day before every sacrifice, the emperor mounted the Qingcheng Gate to observe the vigil performance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before every sacrifice, the emperor went to the Qingcheng Gate to observe the vigil performance.

sentences.zh: 若車駕巡幸，則夜奏於行宮前，人數減於大禮，凡用八百八十人。

translations.literal: If the imperial train toured, then at night they performed before the traveling palace; the number of men was reduced from the great ceremony, in all using 880.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial train went on tour, the music was performed at night before the traveling palace; the complement was smaller than at a great ceremony, totaling 880 men.

sentences.zh: （真宗崇奉聖祖，亦設儀衛，別作導引曲，今附之。）〉

translations.literal: (Emperor Zhenzong revered the Sage Ancestor, also established guard of honor, and separately composed guiding-procession pieces; these are appended here.)
translations.idiomatic: (Because Emperor Zhenzong revered the Sage Ancestor, he also established a guard of honor and separately composed guiding-procession pieces, which are appended here.)

sentences.zh: 《兩朝志》云：“大駕千七百九十三人，法駕千三百五人，小駕千三十四人，

translations.literal: The Record of the Two Reigns says: "The grand carriage 1,793 men, the regulated carriage 1,305, the minor carriage 1,034,
translations.idiomatic: The Record of the Two Reigns states: "The grand carriage employed 1,793 men, the regulated carriage 1,305, the minor carriage 1,034,

sentences.zh: （人數多於前。）〉

translations.literal: (the numbers are greater than before.)
translations.idiomatic: (all larger complements than before.)

sentences.zh: 鑾駕九百二十五人。

translations.literal: The imperial escort 925 men.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial escort employed 925 men.

sentences.zh: 迎奉祖宗御容或神主祔廟，用小鑾駕三百二十五人，上宗廟諡冊二百人，其曲即隨時更製。

translations.literal: When welcoming and escorting the imperial portraits of the ancestors or enshrining spirit tablets in the temple, the minor imperial escort used 325 men; presenting posthumous titles at the ancestral temple used 200; the pieces were then newly composed according to the occasion.
translations.idiomatic: When welcoming the imperial portraits of the ancestors or enshrining spirit tablets in the temple, the minor imperial escort used 325 men; presenting posthumous titles at the ancestral temple used 200. The pieces were newly composed according to the occasion.

sentences.zh: 自天聖已來，帝郊祀、躬耕籍田，皇太后恭謝宗廟，悉用正宮《降仙台》、《導引》、《六州》、《十二時》，凡四曲。

translations.literal: From Tiansheng onward, when the emperor performed suburban sacrifice, personally plowed the sacred field, or the empress dowager reverently thanked the ancestral temple, all used the zhenggong mode: Descent of the Immortal Terrace, Guiding Procession, Six Prefectures, and Twelve Hours—in all four pieces.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tiansheng era onward, whenever the emperor performed suburban sacrifice or personally plowed the sacred field, or the empress dowager reverently thanked the ancestral temple, all used the zhenggong mode: Descent of the Immortal Terrace, Guiding Procession, Six Prefectures, and Twelve Hours—four pieces in all.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年，郊祀減《導引》第二曲，增《奉禋歌》。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyou, suburban sacrifice reduced the second Guiding Procession piece and added Offering at the Altar Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyou [1035], suburban sacrifice dropped the second Guiding Procession piece and added Offering at the Altar Song.

sentences.zh: 初，李照等撰警嚴曲，請以《振容》為名，帝以其義無取，故更曰《奉禋》。

translations.literal: At first Li Zhao and others composed a vigil piece and requested the name Stirring Countenance; the emperor found the meaning unacceptable, so it was changed to Offering at the Altar.
translations.idiomatic: At first Li Zhao and others composed a vigil piece and proposed naming it Stirring Countenance; the emperor found the meaning unsuitable, so it was renamed Offering at the Altar.

sentences.zh: 其後袷享太廟亦用之。

translations.literal: Afterward it was also used at the combined seasonal offering in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: It was later used at the combined seasonal offering in the Imperial Ancestral Temple as well.

sentences.zh: 大享明堂用黃鍾宮，增《合宮歌》。

translations.literal: The great offering at the Bright Hall used the huangzhong mode and added Hall of Union Song.
translations.idiomatic: The great offering at the Bright Hall used the huangzhong mode and added Hall of Union Song.

sentences.zh: 凡山陵導引靈駕，章獻、章懿皇后用正平調，仁宗用黃鍾羽，增《昭陵歌》。

translations.literal: For all imperial tombs guiding the spirit carriage, Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi used the zhengping mode; Renzong used huangzhong yu, with Zhao Mausoleum Song added.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the spirit carriage was guided to an imperial tomb, Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi used the zhengping mode; Renzong used huangzhong yu, with Zhao Mausoleum Song added.

sentences.zh: 神主還宮，用大石調，增《虞神歌》。

translations.literal: When spirit tablets returned to the palace, the dashi mode was used, with Receiving the Spirit Song added.
translations.idiomatic: When spirit tablets returned to the palace, the dashi mode was used and Receiving the Spirit Song was added.

sentences.zh: 凡迎奉祖宗御容赴宮觀、寺院並神主祔廟，悉用正宮，惟仁宗御容赴景靈宮改用道調，皆止一曲。

translations.literal: For all occasions welcoming and escorting ancestral imperial portraits to palaces, temples, and monasteries, or enshrining spirit tablets, all used zhenggong; only when Renzong's portrait went to Jingling Palace was the dao mode used instead—each only one piece.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever ancestral imperial portraits were welcomed to palaces, temples, and monasteries, or when spirit tablets were enshrined, zhenggong was used throughout; only when Renzong's portrait went to Jingling Palace was the dao mode used instead. In each case only one piece was performed.

sentences.zh: 皇祐中大饗明堂，帝謂輔臣曰：“明堂直端門，而致齋於內，奏嚴於外，恐失靖恭之意。

translations.literal: In Huangyou, at the great offering in the Bright Hall, the emperor said to his chief ministers: "The Bright Hall faces directly on the Duan Gate, yet fasting is within while the vigil is performed outside—I fear this loses the meaning of reverent composure.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangyou [1049–1054], at the great offering in the Bright Hall, the emperor told his chief ministers: "The Bright Hall faces directly on the Duan Gate, yet we fast within while the vigil is performed outside. I fear this falls short of reverent composure.

sentences.zh: ”詔禮官議之，鹹言：“警場本古之鼛鼓，所謂夜戒守鼓者也。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the ritual officials to deliberate. All said: "The watch ground is originally the ancient gao drum—what is called the night-watch guard drum.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the ritual officials to deliberate. All agreed: "The watch ground derives from the ancient gao drum—the so-called night-watch guard drum.

sentences.zh: 王者師行、吉行皆用之。

translations.literal: Kings on military marches and auspicious journeys all used it.
translations.idiomatic: Kings employed it on military campaigns and on auspicious journeys alike.

sentences.zh: 今乘輿宿齋，本緣祀事，則警場亦因以警眾，非徒取觀聽之盛，恐不可廢。

translations.literal: Now when the imperial carriage lodges for fasting, it is fundamentally because of the sacrifice; then the watch ground also thereby warns the multitude—not merely for the grandeur of sight and sound—I fear it cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage lodges for fasting, it is fundamentally for the sake of the sacrifice, and the watch ground likewise warns the multitude. It is not merely for spectacle, and we fear it cannot be abolished.

sentences.zh: 若以奏嚴之音去明堂近，則請列於宣德門百步之外，俟行禮時，罷奏一嚴，亦足以稱虔恭之意。

translations.literal: If the sound of the vigil performance is too near the Bright Hall, then we request it be arrayed more than a hundred paces outside the Xuande Gate; when the rites are performed, suspend one vigil performance—this too would suffice to express reverent devotion.
translations.idiomatic: If the vigil music is too close to the Bright Hall, we ask that it be stationed more than a hundred paces outside the Xuande Gate, and that one vigil performance be suspended during the rites. That would still suffice to express reverent devotion.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“既不可廢，則祀前一夕邇於接神，宜罷之。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Since it cannot be abolished, then on the eve of the sacrifice, when we are close to receiving the spirits, it should be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Since it cannot be abolished, then on the eve of the sacrifice, when we are close to receiving the spirits, it should be suspended.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，親祠南郊，曲五奏，正宮《導引》、《奉禋》、《降仙台》；

translations.literal: In the Xining era, when the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, five pieces were performed: zhenggong Guiding Procession, Offering at the Altar, and Descent of the Immortal Terrace;
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era [1068–1077], when the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, five pieces were performed in zhenggong: Guiding Procession, Offering at the Altar, and Descent of the Immortal Terrace;

sentences.zh: 祠明堂，曲四奏，黃鍾宮《導引》、《合宮歌》：皆以《六州》、《十二時》。

translations.literal: sacrifice at the Bright Hall, four pieces: huangzhong Guiding Procession and Hall of Union Song—with Six Prefectures and Twelve Hours.
translations.idiomatic: at sacrifice in the Bright Hall, four pieces in huangzhong: Guiding Procession and Hall of Union Song—with Six Prefectures and Twelve Hours.

sentences.zh: 永厚陵導引、警場及神主還宮，皆四曲，虞主祔廟、奉安慈聖光獻皇后山陵亦如之。

translations.literal: Yonghou Mausoleum guiding, watch ground, and spirit tablets returning to the palace were all four pieces; enshrining spirit tablets and installing Empress Cisheng Guangxian at her tomb were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Guiding the Yonghou Mausoleum, the watch ground, and the return of spirit tablets to the palace each used four pieces; enshrining spirit tablets and installing Empress Cisheng Guangxian at her tomb followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 諸後告遷、升祔、上仁宗、英宗徽號，迎太一宮神像，亦以一曲導引，率因事隨時定所屬宮調，以律和之。

translations.literal: When empresses announced relocation, were elevated for enshrinement, or posthumous titles were presented for Renzong and Yingzong, or when welcoming the spirit image at the Grand Unity Palace, likewise one guiding piece—generally the mode was fixed according to the occasion and harmonized by the pitch pipes.
translations.idiomatic: When empresses announced relocation, were elevated for enshrinement, or posthumous titles were presented for Renzong and Yingzong, or when the spirit image was welcomed at the Grand Unity Palace, one guiding piece was likewise used; the mode was generally fixed according to the occasion and harmonized by the pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，言者以鼓吹害雅樂，欲調治之，令與正聲相得。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, memorialists said acclamations harmed elegant music and wished to regulate them so they would accord with the correct tones.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era [1078–1085], memorialists argued that acclamations harmed elegant music and proposed regulating them so they would accord with the correct tones.

sentences.zh: 楊傑言：“正樂者，先王之德音，所以感召和氣、格降上神、移變風俗，而鼓吹者，軍旅之樂耳。

translations.literal: Yang Jie said: "Correct music is the virtuous sound of the former kings, by which to summon harmonious qi, draw down the highest spirits, and transform customs; acclamations are merely military music.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jie said: "Correct music is the virtuous sound of the former kings, by which to summon harmonious qi, draw down the highest spirits, and transform customs; acclamations are merely military music.

sentences.zh: 蓋鼓角橫吹，起於西域，聖人存四夷之樂，所以一天下也；

translations.literal: Drums, horns, and transverse flutes arose in the Western Regions; the sage preserved the music of the four barbarians in order to unify all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Drums, horns, and transverse flutes arose in the Western Regions. The sage preserved the music of the four barbarians in order to unify all under Heaven;

sentences.zh: 存軍旅之樂，示不忘武備也。

translations.literal: he preserved military music to show that martial preparedness was not forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: he preserved military music to show that martial preparedness was not forgotten.

sentences.zh: ‘鞮鞻氏掌夷樂與其聲歌，祭祀則龡而歌之，燕亦如之。

translations.literal: 'The Di-Li clan oversees barbarian music and its songs; at sacrifices they blow and sing them; at banquets likewise.
translations.idiomatic: 'The Di-Li clan oversees barbarian music and its songs; at sacrifices they blow and sing them, and at banquets likewise.

sentences.zh: ’今大祀，車駕所在，則鼓吹與武嚴之樂陳於門而更奏之，以備警嚴。

translations.literal: ' At great sacrifices today, where the imperial train is lodged, acclamations and martial guard music are arrayed at the gate and performed at each watch to provide vigil and guard.
translations.idiomatic: ' At great sacrifices today, wherever the imperial train lodges, acclamations and martial guard music are arrayed at the gate and performed at each watch to provide vigil and guard.

sentences.zh: 大朝會則鼓吹列於宮架之外，其器既異先代之器，而施設概與正樂不同。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies acclamations are arrayed outside the palace frame; their instruments already differ from those of former ages, and their deployment is generally unlike correct music.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies, acclamations are arrayed outside the palace frame. Their instruments already differ from those of former ages, and their deployment is generally unlike correct music.

sentences.zh: 國初以來，奏大樂則鼓吹備而不作，同名為樂，而用實異。

translations.literal: Since the founding of the dynasty, when grand music is performed acclamations are prepared but not played; though both are called music, their use is in fact different.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, when grand music is performed, acclamations are prepared but not played. Though both are called music, their use is in fact different.

sentences.zh: 雖其音聲間有符合，而宮調稱謂不可淆混。

translations.literal: Although their sounds sometimes accord, the modes and names cannot be confused.
translations.idiomatic: Although their sounds sometimes accord, the modes and names must not be confused.

sentences.zh: 故大樂以十二律呂名之，鼓吹之樂則曰正宮之類而已。

translations.literal: Therefore grand music is named by the twelve pitch pipes and modes; acclamation music is only called zhenggong and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Grand music is therefore named by the twelve pitch pipes and modes, whereas acclamation music is only called zhenggong and the like.

sentences.zh: （乾德中，設鼓吹十二案，製氈床十二，為熊羆騰倚之狀。

translations.literal: (In Qiande, twelve acclamation platforms were established; twelve felt couches were made in the shape of bears and panthers leaping and reclining.
translations.idiomatic: (In Qiande [963–968], twelve acclamation platforms were established, with twelve felt couches shaped like bears and panthers leaping and reclining.

sentences.zh: 每案設大鼓、羽葆鼓、金錞各一，歌、簫、笳各二。

translations.literal: Each platform had one large drum, plumed-banner drum, and golden chun; two singers, xiao, and jia each.
translations.idiomatic: Each platform had one large drum, plumed-banner drum, and golden chun, and two singers, xiao, and jia each.

sentences.zh: 又有叉手笛，名曰拱宸管，考驗皆與雅音相應，列於宮縣之籍，編之令式。）〉

translations.literal: There were also crossed-hand flutes called Arching-the-Palace Pipes; examination showed all accorded with elegant tones. They were listed in the palace-frame register and codified in regulations.)
translations.idiomatic: There were also crossed-hand flutes called Arching-the-Palace Pipes; examination showed that all accorded with elegant tones. They were listed in the palace-frame register and codified in regulations.)

sentences.zh: 若以律呂變易夷部宮調，則名混同而樂相紊亂矣。

translations.literal: If pitch pipes and modes were used to alter the modes of the barbarian sections, then names would be confused and the music mutually disordered.
translations.idiomatic: If pitch pipes and modes were used to alter the modes of the barbarian sections, names would be confused and the music thrown into disorder.

sentences.zh: ”遂不復行。

translations.literal: " Thus it was not carried out again.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was therefore not carried out.

sentences.zh: 元符三年七月，學士院奏：“太常寺鼓吹局應奉大行皇帝山陵鹵簿、鼓吹、儀仗，並嚴更、警場歌詞樂章，依例撰成。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yuanfu, the Academy of Scholar-Officials memorialized: "The Grand Music Office Acclamations Bureau, in service to the late emperor's tomb procession, insignia, acclamations, guard of honor, and the lyrics and pieces for vigil watches and the watch ground, have been composed according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Yuanfu [1100], the Academy of Scholar-Officials memorialized: "The Acclamations Bureau of the Grand Music Office has composed, according to precedent, the tomb procession, insignia, acclamations, guard of honor, and the lyrics and pieces for vigil watches and the watch ground for the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 靈駕發引至陵所，仙呂調《導引》等九首，已令樂工協比聲律。

translations.literal: From the spirit carriage's departure to the tomb site, nine pieces in xianlü mode including Guiding Procession—the musicians have been ordered to harmonize the pitch and modes.
translations.idiomatic: For the spirit carriage's departure to the tomb site, nine pieces in xianlü mode including Guiding Procession have been set, and the musicians have been ordered to harmonize pitch and mode.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 政和七年三月，議禮局言：“古者鐃歌、鼓吹曲各易其名，以紀功烈。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year of Zhenghe, the Ritual Deliberation Bureau said: "In antiquity nao songs and acclamation pieces each changed their names to record achievements and merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year of Zhenghe [1117], the Ritual Deliberation Bureau said: "In antiquity, nao songs and acclamation pieces each changed their names to record achievements and merit.

sentences.zh: 今所設鼓吹，唯備警衛而已，未有鐃歌之曲，非所以彰休德、揚偉績也。

translations.literal: The acclamations established today only provide guard and escort; there are no nao-song pieces—this is not how to display resting virtue and spread great deeds.
translations.idiomatic: The acclamations established today serve only as guard and escort; there are no nao-song pieces. This is not how to display resting virtue and spread great deeds.

sentences.zh: 乞詔儒臣討論撰述，因事命名，審協聲律，播之鼓吹，俾工師習之。

translations.literal: We beg an edict for scholar-officials to discuss and compose, naming according to events, carefully harmonizing pitch and mode, disseminating them through acclamations, and causing the musicians to learn them.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that scholar-officials be ordered to discuss and compose pieces, naming them according to events, carefully harmonizing pitch and mode, disseminating them through acclamations, and having the musicians learn them.

sentences.zh: 凡王師大獻，則令鼓吹具奏，以聳群聽。

translations.literal: Whenever the royal army made a great presentation of captives, then order acclamations to perform them all, to lift the ears of the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the royal army presented great captives, acclamations should perform them all, to stir the ears of the multitude.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔《六州》改名《崇明祀》，《十二時》改名《稱吉禮》，《導引》改名《熙事備成》，六引內者，設而不作。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict renamed Six Prefectures to Honoring the Sacred Offering, Twelve Hours to Proclaiming the Auspicious Rite, and Guiding Procession to Splendid Affairs Fully Accomplished; within the six processional sections they were set out but not performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict renamed Six Prefectures to Honoring the Sacred Offering, Twelve Hours to Proclaiming the Auspicious Rite, and Guiding Procession to Splendid Affairs Fully Accomplished. Within the six processional sections they were displayed but not performed.

sentences.zh: 紹興十六年，臣僚言：“國家大饗、乘輿齋宿必設警場，肅儀衛而嚴祀事。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shaoxing, officials memorialized: "At the state's great offerings, when the imperial carriage fasts and lodges, a watch ground must be established to solemnize the guard of honor and make the sacrifice strict.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shaoxing [1146], officials memorialized: "At the state's great offerings, when the imperial carriage fasts and lodges, a watch ground must be established to solemnize the guard of honor and make the sacrifice strict.

sentences.zh: 樂工隸太常，歌詞備三疊，累朝以來皆用之。

translations.literal: Musicians are subordinate to the Grand Music Office; lyrics are provided in three stanzas; successive reigns have all used them.
translations.idiomatic: The musicians belong to the Grand Music Office, the lyrics are provided in three stanzas, and successive reigns have all used them.

sentences.zh: 比者郊廟行事，率代以鉦、鼓，取諸殿司。

translations.literal: Recently at suburban and temple ceremonies, gongs and drums from the palace bureaus have generally been substituted.
translations.idiomatic: Recently at suburban and temple ceremonies, gongs and drums from the palace bureaus have generally been substituted instead.

sentences.zh: 夫軍旅、祭祀，事既異，宜樂聲清濁，用以殊尚。

translations.literal: Military affairs and sacrifices are different matters; the music should differ in clarity and weight to mark the distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs and sacrifices are different matters; the music should differ in clarity and weight to mark the distinction.

sentences.zh: 鉦、鼓、鳴角列於鹵簿中，所以示觀德之盛，宜詔有司更製，兼籍鼓吹樂工以時閱習，遇熙事出而用之。

translations.literal: Gongs, drums, and sounding horns arrayed in the procession display the grandeur of observed virtue; the responsible offices should be ordered to remake them, register acclamation musicians for timely review and practice, and use them when splendid affairs proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Gongs, drums, and sounding horns arrayed in the procession display the grandeur of observed virtue. The responsible offices should be ordered to remake them, register acclamation musicians for timely review and practice, and deploy them when splendid affairs proceed.

sentences.zh: ”有司請下軍器所造節鼓一，奏嚴鼓一百二十，鳴角亦如之，金鉦二十有四。

translations.literal: " The responsible offices requested the Armory Bureau to make one marking drum, 120 vigil drums, sounding horns in like number, and 24 golden gongs.
translations.idiomatic: " The responsible offices asked the Armory Bureau to make one marking drum, 120 vigil drums, an equal number of sounding horns, and 24 golden gongs.

sentences.zh: 太常前後部振作通用一千八百五十七人，而鼓吹益盛。

translations.literal: The front and rear sections of the Grand Music Office in all used 1,857 men, and acclamations grew ever more elaborate.
translations.idiomatic: The front and rear sections of the Grand Music Office together used 1,857 men, and acclamations grew ever more elaborate.

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興二年，兵部言：“奉明詔，大禮乘輿服禦，除玉輅、平輦等外，所用人數並從省約。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing under Xiaozong, the Ministry of War said: "In obedience to the enlightened edict, for great ceremonies when the imperial carriage is used, apart from the jade chariot, level palanquin, and the like, the numbers employed are all to be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longxing [1164] under Emperor Xiaozong, the Ministry of War reported: "In obedience to the enlightened edict, for great ceremonies when the imperial carriage is used, apart from the jade chariot, level palanquin, and the like, all complements are to be reduced.

sentences.zh: 內鼓吹合用八百四十一人，止用五百八十八人；

translations.literal: Inner acclamations should use 841 men in all, but only 588 are used;
translations.idiomatic: Inner acclamations should use 841 men in all, but only 588 are used;

sentences.zh: 警場合用二百七十五人，止用一百三十人。

translations.literal: the watch ground should use 275, but only 130.
translations.idiomatic: the watch ground should use 275, but only 130.

sentences.zh: ”淳熙中大閱，帝自祥曦殿戎服而出，皇太子、親王、執政以下並從，諸將皆介胄乘馬導駕，軍器分衛前後，奏隨軍鼓管大樂。

translations.literal: " In the Chunxi era at the great review, the emperor came forth in military dress from the Xiangxi Hall; the crown prince, imperial princes, chief ministers, and all below followed; the generals all wore armor and rode horses to guide the carriage; military equipment guarded front and rear; they performed the grand music of camp drums and pipes.
translations.idiomatic: " During the Chunxi era [1174–1189] at the great review, the emperor came forth in military dress from the Xiangxi Hall. The crown prince, imperial princes, chief ministers, and all below followed; the generals all wore armor and rode horses to guide the carriage; military equipment guarded front and rear; and the grand music of camp drums and pipes was performed.

sentences.zh: 上尋易金甲，乘馬升將台，殿帥舉黃旗，諸軍呼拜，奏發嚴，中軍鳴角。

translations.literal: The emperor soon changed into golden armor, mounted a horse, and ascended the command platform; the palace commander raised the yellow flag; the armies shouted and bowed; they performed the opening vigil; the central army sounded horns.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor soon changed into golden armor, mounted a horse, and ascended the command platform. The palace commander raised the yellow flag; the armies shouted and bowed; the opening vigil was performed; and the central army sounded horns.

sentences.zh: 馬步簇隊，連三鼓。

translations.literal: Cavalry and infantry massed in formation; three drums in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry and infantry massed in formation to three drumbeats in succession.

sentences.zh: 至四鼓，舉白旗，中軍鼓聲旗應，乃變方陣。

translations.literal: At the fourth drum, the white flag was raised; central-army drums and flags answered, and they changed to square formation.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth drum, the white flag was raised; the central army's drums and flags answered, and the troops changed to square formation.

sentences.zh: 別高一鼓，馬步軍出陣。

translations.literal: At one drum higher, cavalry and infantry emerged from formation.
translations.idiomatic: At one drum higher, cavalry and infantry emerged from formation.

sentences.zh: 別高一鼓，各歸部隊。

translations.literal: At one drum higher, each returned to his unit.
translations.idiomatic: At one drum higher, each returned to his unit.

sentences.zh: 五鼓舉黃旗，變員陣。

translations.literal: At the fifth drum the yellow flag was raised; they changed to circular formation.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth drum the yellow flag was raised, and the troops changed to circular formation.

sentences.zh: 又鼓，舉赤旗，變銳陣；

translations.literal: At another drum, the red flag was raised; they changed to pointed formation;
translations.idiomatic: At another drum, the red flag was raised and the troops changed to pointed formation;

sentences.zh: 青旗變直陣。

translations.literal: the green flag, to straight formation.
translations.idiomatic: the green flag signaled a change to straight formation.

sentences.zh: 收鼓訖，一金止，重鼓鳴角，簇隊放教。

translations.literal: When the drums ceased, one metal stopped them; heavy drums and horns sounded; the massed formations were released for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: When the drums ceased, one gong stopped them; heavy drums and horns sounded, and the massed formations were released for drill.

sentences.zh: 此其凡也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: This is the general outline.

sentences.zh: △開寶元年南郊三首《導引》

translations.literal: △ First year of Kaibao, suburban sacrifice, three pieces, Guiding Procession
translations.idiomatic: △ Kaibao 1 [968]: suburban sacrifice, three Guiding Procession pieces

sentences.zh: 氣和玉燭，睿化著鴻明，緹管一陽生。

translations.literal: Qi harmonized, jade candles balanced, sagely transformation displayed great clarity; crimson pipes—one yang is born.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious qi and balanced seasons, sagely rule shining clear; crimson pitch-pipes mark the birth of yang.

sentences.zh: 郊禋盛禮燔柴畢，旋軫鳳凰城。

translations.literal: The suburban rite's grand ceremony, firewood burning finished, the carriage turns back to Phoenix City.
translations.idiomatic: When the great suburban rite and burnt offering were complete, the carriage turned back toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 森羅儀衛振華纓，載路溢歡聲。

translations.literal: Arrayed guards and escorts shook splendid tassels; the road overflowed with joyous voices.
translations.idiomatic: Rank upon rank of guards shook their splendid tassels, and the road rang with joyous voices.

sentences.zh: 皇圖大業超前古，垂象泰階平。

translations.literal: The imperial design and great enterprise surpass antiquity; the hanging image—Grand Steps are level.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial enterprise surpasses antiquity; heaven's signs show the Grand Steps made level.

sentences.zh: 歲時豐衍，九土樂升平，睹寰海澄清。

translations.literal: Seasons abundant and full, the nine regions rejoice in peace, beholding all within the seas clarified.
translations.idiomatic: The seasons run rich and full; the nine regions rejoice in peace, and all within the seas is clear.

sentences.zh: 道高堯、舜垂衣治，日月並文明。

translations.literal: The Way surpasses Yao and Shun's rule with robes hanging down; sun and moon together are civilized and bright.
translations.idiomatic: His Way rises above Yao and Shun's effortless rule; sun and moon alike shine with civilization.

sentences.zh: 《嘉禾》、《甘露》登歌薦，雲物煥祥經。

translations.literal: Fine Grain and Sweet Dew—ascending song presented; cloud omens renew auspicious scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Grain and Sweet Dew were offered in ascending song, and cloud omens renewed the signs of blessing.

sentences.zh: 兢兢惕惕持謙德，未許禪雲、亭。

translations.literal: Cautious and vigilant, holding modest virtue, not yet permitted to abdicate at Cloud Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Cautious and vigilant in modest virtue, he has not yet been permitted to ascend Mount Tai and abdicate.

sentences.zh: 《六州》

translations.literal: Six Prefectures
translations.idiomatic: Six Prefectures

sentences.zh: 嚴夜警，銅蓮漏遲遲。

translations.literal: Strict night watch; the bronze lotus clepsydra drips slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The strict night watch sounds; the bronze lotus clepsydra drips slowly.

sentences.zh: 清禁肅，森陛戟，羽衛儼皇闈。

translations.literal: The clear forbidden precinct is solemn; halberds dense on the steps; feathered guards stand in awe at the imperial gate.
translations.idiomatic: The forbidden precinct stands solemn; halberds line the steps; feathered guards stand in awe at the imperial gate.

sentences.zh: 角聲勵，鉦鼓攸宜。

translations.literal: Horn sounds urge on; gongs and drums are altogether fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Horns urge the ranks onward; gongs and drums beat as they should.

sentences.zh: 金管成雅奏，逐吹逶迤。

translations.literal: Golden pipes complete the elegant performance, following the windings of the blow.
translations.idiomatic: Golden pipes complete the elegant performance, winding on with the breath of the flutes.

sentences.zh: 薦蒼璧，郊祀神祗，屬景運純禧。

translations.literal: Present the dark jade disk; suburban sacrifice to the spirits—belonging to the age's pure blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The dark jade disk is offered in suburban sacrifice to the spirits, fitting this age of pure blessing.

sentences.zh: 京坻豐衍，群材樂育，諸侯述職，盛德服蠻夷。

translations.literal: Capital mounds abundant and spreading; all talents joyfully nurtured; feudal lords report their duties; great virtue subdues the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's granaries overflow; talents flourish; feudal lords report their duties; great virtue brings the barbarians to submission.

sentences.zh: 殊祥萃，九苞丹鳳來儀。

translations.literal: Rare auspices gather; the nine-fold crimson phoenix comes in ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Rare omens gather; the nine-fold crimson phoenix arrives in ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 膏露降，和氣洽，三秀煥靈芝。

translations.literal: Rich dew descends; harmonious qi pervades; three blooms brighten the spirit fungus.
translations.idiomatic: Rich dew descends, harmonious qi pervades, and three blooms brighten the spirit fungus.

sentences.zh: 鴻猷播，史冊相輝。

translations.literal: Great design spreads; histories and registers shine together.
translations.idiomatic: His great design spreads abroad; histories and registers shine together.

sentences.zh: 張四維，卜世永固丕基。

translations.literal: Extend the four bonds; divination—generations forever secure the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: He extends the four bonds of rule; the oracle shows generations securing the great foundation forever.

sentences.zh: 敷玄化，蕩蕩無為，合堯、舜文思。

translations.literal: Spread the dark transformation; vast and effortless; matching Yao and Shun's literary thought.
translations.idiomatic: He spreads the subtle transformation, vast and effortless, matching the literary mind of Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 混並寰宇，休牛歸馬，銷金偃革，蹈詠慶昌期。

translations.literal: Merge and unite all within the seas; rest the oxen, return the horses; melt the metal, lay down the hides; tread and sing, celebrating the flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: All within the seas is united; oxen rest and horses return home; arms are stilled; the people dance and sing, celebrating a flourishing age.

sentences.zh: 《十二時》

translations.literal: Twelve Hours
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Hours

sentences.zh: 承寶運，馴致隆平，鴻慶被寰瀛。

translations.literal: Receiving the precious mandate, gently attaining abundant peace; great celebration covers all within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the precious mandate, he gently brings abundant peace; great celebration covers all within the seas.

sentences.zh: 時清俗阜，治定功成，遐邇詠《由庚》。

translations.literal: Times clear, customs rich; rule settled, merit achieved; far and near sing You Geng.
translations.idiomatic: The age is clear and customs flourish; rule is settled and merit achieved; far and near sing You Geng.

sentences.zh: 嚴郊祀，文物聲明。

translations.literal: Solemn suburban sacrifice; cultural implements and their sounds made clear.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban sacrifice is solemn; ritual implements and music resound with clarity.

sentences.zh: 會天正，星拱奏嚴更，布羽儀簪纓。

translations.literal: Meeting the celestial first month; stars arching, performing the vigil watches; deploying feathered insignia and official caps.
translations.idiomatic: At the year's first month, stars wheel overhead as vigil music sounds; feathered insignia and official caps are arrayed.

sentences.zh: 宸心虔潔，明德播惟馨。

translations.literal: The imperial heart devout and pure; bright virtue spreads its fragrance alone.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart is devout and pure; bright virtue spreads its fragrance abroad.

sentences.zh: 動蒼冥，神降享精誠。

translations.literal: Moving the dark heavens; spirits descend to enjoy sincere devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The dark heavens are stirred; the spirits descend to receive sincere devotion.

sentences.zh: 燔柴半，萬乘移天仗，肅鑾輅旋衡。

translations.literal: Firewood burning half done; ten thousand chariots move the celestial guard; solemnly the imperial carriage turns the crossbar.
translations.idiomatic: The burnt offering is half complete; the imperial train moves on; the imperial carriage solemnly turns homeward.

sentences.zh: 千官雲擁，群後葵傾，玉帛旅明庭。

translations.literal: A thousand officials cloud-clustering; all lords sunflowers tilting; jade and silk array in the bright court.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand officials crowd like clouds; all lords incline like sunflowers; jade and silk are arrayed in the bright court.

sentences.zh: 《韶》、《》薦，金奏諧聲，集休亨。

translations.literal: Shao and "" presented; golden performance harmonizes in sound; blessing and prosperity gather.
translations.idiomatic: Shao and Wu dances are offered in ascending presentation; golden music harmonizes, gathering blessing and prosperity.

sentences.zh: 皇澤浹黎庶，普率洽恩榮。

translations.literal: Imperial bounty saturates the common people; universally led, grace and honor pervade.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial bounty saturates the common people; all are united in grace and honor.

sentences.zh: 仰欽元後，睿聖貫三靈。

translations.literal: Looking up in reverence to the primary sovereign; sagely brilliance penetrating the three spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We look up in reverence to the supreme sovereign, whose sagely brilliance unites heaven, earth, and man.

sentences.zh: 萬邦寧，景貺福千齡。

translations.literal: Ten thousand states at peace; bright gifts, blessing for a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states are at peace; bright gifts bring blessing for a thousand ages.

sentences.zh: △真宗封禪四首《導引》

translations.literal: △ Zhenzong feng-shan, four pieces, Guiding Procession
translations.idiomatic: △ Zhenzong feng-shan: four Guiding Procession pieces

sentences.zh: 民康俗阜，萬國樂升平，慶海晏河清。

translations.literal: The people at ease, customs rich; ten thousand states rejoice in peace; celebrating seas calm and rivers clear.
translations.idiomatic: The people are at ease and customs flourish; ten thousand states rejoice in peace, celebrating seas calm and rivers clear.

sentences.zh: 唐堯、虞舜垂衣化，詎比我皇明！

translations.literal: Tang Yao and Yu Shun's transformation with robes hanging down—how can they compare with our emperor's brilliance!
translations.idiomatic: Yao and Shun ruled effortlessly—how can they compare with our emperor's brilliance!

sentences.zh: 九天寶命垂丕貺，雲物效祥英。

translations.literal: The nine heavens' precious mandate bestows great gifts; cloud omens display auspicious splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's precious mandate bestows great gifts; cloud omens display auspicious splendor.

sentences.zh: 星羅羽衛登喬嶽，親告禪雲、亭。

translations.literal: Stars arrayed, feathered guards ascend the lofty peak; in person reporting the abdication at Cloud Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Guards arrayed like stars ascend the lofty peak; in person he reports the rite at Cloud Pavilion.

sentences.zh: （汾陰云：“星羅羽衛臨汾曲，親享答資生。

translations.literal: (At Fenyin it says: "Stars arrayed, feathered guards come to the Fen bend; in person offering to answer the nurturing of life.
translations.idiomatic: (The Fenyin version reads: "Guards arrayed like stars come to the Fen bend; in person he offers to answer the nurturing of life."

sentences.zh: 我皇垂拱，惠化洽文明，盛禮慶重行。

translations.literal: Our emperor with robes hanging down; gracious transformation pervades civilization; the grand rite celebrates its renewed performance.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor rules effortlessly; gracious transformation pervades civilization; the grand rite celebrates its renewed performance.

sentences.zh: 登封、降禪燔柴畢，

translations.literal: Ascending the feng, descending the shan, firewood burning finished,
translations.idiomatic: The feng ascent, shan descent, and burnt offering complete,

sentences.zh: （汾陰云：“告虔睢上皇儀畢。

translations.literal: (At Fenyin it says: "Reporting devotion at Sui Heights, the imperial rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: (The Fenyin version reads: "Reporting devotion at Sui Heights, the imperial rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 天仗入神京。

translations.literal: the celestial guard enters the divine capital.
translations.idiomatic: the imperial guard enters the divine capital.

sentences.zh: 雲雷布澤遍寰瀛，遐邇振歡聲。

translations.literal: Cloud and thunder spread bounty through all within the seas; far and near stir with joyous voices.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud and thunder spread bounty through all within the seas; far and near ring with joyous voices.

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong

sentences.zh: 乘雲英聖，千載仰皇靈，垂法藹朝經。

translations.literal: Riding clouds, heroic sage; a thousand years look up to imperial spirit; hanging law suffuses court canon.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud-riding heroic sage—for a thousand years men look up to his imperial spirit; his hanging law suffuses the court canon.

sentences.zh: 禹金鎔範肖儀刑，日角煥珠庭。

translations.literal: Yu-dynasty gold smelted and cast to match exemplary form; sun-horn shining in pearl court.
translations.idiomatic: Yu-dynasty gold is smelted and cast to match his exemplary form; the sun-horn shines in the pearl court.

sentences.zh: 琳宮翠殿鳳文屏，迎奉慶安寧。

translations.literal: Jade palace, emerald hall, phoenix-pattern screens; welcoming and escorting for celebration and peace.
translations.idiomatic: Jade palace and emerald hall with phoenix-pattern screens welcome and escort him in celebration and peace.

sentences.zh: 孝思瞻謁薦惟馨，誠愨貫青冥。

translations.literal: Filial thought, gazing in audience, offering only fragrance; sincere reverence pierces azure heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In filial thought he gazes in audience, offering only fragrance; sincere reverence pierces the azure heaven.

sentences.zh: △奉寶冊《導引》三首

translations.literal: △ Presenting precious registers, Guiding Procession, three pieces
translations.idiomatic: △ Presenting precious registers: three Guiding Procession pieces

sentences.zh: 《玉清昭應宮》

translations.literal: Yujing Zhaoying Palace
translations.idiomatic: Yujing Zhaoying Palace

sentences.zh: 太霄垂佑，綿宇洽祺祥，祕檢煥雲章。

translations.literal: Highest empyrean hangs protection; broad realm harmonizes with lucky signs; secret archive shines with cloud scripture.
translations.idiomatic: The highest empyrean hangs its protection; the broad realm harmonizes with lucky signs; the secret archive shines with cloud scripture.

sentences.zh: 宸心虔奉崇徽號，茂典邁前王。

translations.literal: Imperial heart devoutly offers exalted honorific title; flourishing canon surpasses former kings.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart devoutly offers the exalted honorific title; the flourishing canon surpasses former kings.

sentences.zh: 霞明藻衛列通莊，寶冊奉琳房。

translations.literal: Rosy brightness, aquatic guards array on the broad avenue; precious register offered to jade hall.
translations.idiomatic: Rosy brightness gleams as aquatic guards array on the broad avenue; the precious register is offered to the jade hall.

sentences.zh: 都人震抃騰謠頌，億載保歡康。

translations.literal: Capital people tremble with joy, surging with ballads of praise; myriad ages secure in joy and peace.
translations.idiomatic: Capital people tremble with joy, surging in ballads of praise; myriad ages secure in joy and peace.

sentences.zh: 《景靈宮》

translations.literal: Jingling Palace
translations.idiomatic: Jingling Palace

sentences.zh: 明明道祖，金闕冠仙真，清禁降飆輪。

translations.literal: Bright and clear Way-ancestor; golden gate-tower crowned among immortals; pure precinct descends whirlwind carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and clear Way-ancestor, golden gate-tower crowned among immortals; the pure precinct descends in whirlwind carriage.

sentences.zh: 遙源始悟垂鴻慶，億兆聳群倫。

translations.literal: Distant source first perceived hangs great celebration; billions stir among all humanity.
translations.idiomatic: The distant source first perceived hangs great celebration; billions stir among all humanity.

sentences.zh: 虔崇徽號盛儀陳，寶冊奉良辰。

translations.literal: Devoutly exalting honorific title, grand rite displayed; precious register offered on auspicious day.
translations.idiomatic: Devoutly exalting the honorific title, the grand rite is displayed; the precious register is offered on an auspicious day.

sentences.zh: 邦家億載蒙繁祉，聖壽保無垠。

translations.literal: State and family for myriad ages receive abundant blessing; sage longevity preserved without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: State and family for myriad ages receive abundant blessing; sage longevity is preserved without bounds.

sentences.zh: 《太廟》

translations.literal: Imperial Ancestral Temple
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Ancestral Temple

sentences.zh: 祖宗垂佑，亨會協重熙，德澤被烝黎。

translations.literal: Ancestors hang protection; prosperous gathering harmonizes renewed glory; virtue's grace covers the multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors hang their protection; the prosperous gathering harmonizes renewed glory; virtue's grace covers the multitudes.

sentences.zh: 虔崇尊諡陳徽冊，藻衛列葳蕤。

translations.literal: Devoutly exalting posthumous title, displaying honorific register; aquatic guards array in lush splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Devoutly exalting the posthumous title, the honorific register is displayed; aquatic guards array in lush splendor.

sentences.zh: 宸心致孝極孜孜，展禮詔台司。

translations.literal: Imperial heart achieves filial piety with utmost diligence; displaying rites, edict to the directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart achieves filial piety with utmost diligence; displaying the rites, he edicts the directorate.

sentences.zh: 祥煙瑞靄浮清廟，綿宇被純禧。

translations.literal: Auspicious smoke, lucky mist float over the pure temple; broad realm receives pure blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious smoke and lucky mist float over the pure temple; the broad realm receives pure blessing.

sentences.zh: △治平四年英宗祔廟《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Zhiping fourth year, Yingzong enshrined in ancestral temple, Guiding Procession, one piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Zhiping 4 [1067]: Yingzong enshrined in the ancestral temple—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 壽原初掩，歸蹕九虞終，億馭更無蹤。

translations.literal: Longevity plain first closed; returning carriage, nine mourning rites complete; myriad journeying, no trace again.
translations.idiomatic: The longevity plain is first closed; the returning carriage marks the nine mourning rites complete; the myriad journeying leaves no trace again.

sentences.zh: 思皇攀慕追來孝，作廟繼三宗。

translations.literal: The reigning emperor yearns and mourns, pursuing filial piety inherited; building temple to continue the three ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The reigning emperor yearns and mourns, pursuing inherited filial piety; he builds the temple to continue the three ancestors.

sentences.zh: 旌旗居外擁千重，延望相威容。

translations.literal: Banners stand outside, encircling in a thousand folds; gazing from afar at the august countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Banners stand outside, encircling in a thousand folds; from afar they gaze upon the august countenance.

sentences.zh: 寶輿迎引歸新殿，奏享備欽崇。

translations.literal: Precious carriage welcomes and leads back to the new hall; presenting offerings complete with reverent exaltation.
translations.idiomatic: The precious carriage welcomes and leads him back to the new hall; offerings are presented complete with reverent exaltation.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年仁宗、英宗御容赴西京會聖宮應天禪院奉安《導引》一首

translations.literal: Xining second year, Renzong and Yingzong imperial portraits journey to Western Capital Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Chan Monastery for reverent installation, Guiding Procession, one piece
translations.idiomatic: Xining 2 [1069]: Portraits of Renzong and Yingzong journey to the Western Capital's Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Chan Monastery for reverent installation—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 九清三境，飆馭杳難追，功烈並巍巍。

translations.literal: Nine purities, three realms; whirlwind carriage distant, hard to pursue; achievements alike towering.
translations.idiomatic: Nine purities, three realms—the whirlwind carriage is distant and hard to pursue; their achievements alike stand towering.

sentences.zh: 洛都不及西巡到，猶識容歸。

translations.literal: Luoyang capital did not reach the western tour; still recognizing the countenance returning.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang did not reach the western tour, yet still recognizes the returning countenance.

sentences.zh: 三條馳道隱金槌，仙仗共逶迤。

translations.literal: Three imperial thoroughfares hide golden mallets; immortal halberds together wind far.
translations.idiomatic: On the three imperial thoroughfares golden mallets are hidden; immortal halberds wind far together.

sentences.zh: 珠宮紺宇申嚴奉，億載固皇基。

translations.literal: Pearl palace, indigo halls reverently and strictly escorted; myriad ages secure the imperial foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Pearl palace and indigo halls are reverently and strictly escorted; myriad ages secure the imperial foundation.

sentences.zh: △章惠皇太后神主赴西京《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Empress Dowager Zhanghui spirit tablet journeys to Western Capital, Guiding Procession, one piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Empress Dowager Zhanghui's spirit tablet journeys to the Western Capital—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 祥符盛際，二鄙正休兵，瑞應滿寰瀛。

translations.literal: Xiangfu flourishing age; the two frontier regions just ceased arms; auspicious responses fill all within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: In the flourishing age of Xiangfu, the two frontier regions just ceased arms; auspicious responses fill all within the seas.

sentences.zh: 東封西祀鳴鑾輅，從幸見升平。

translations.literal: Eastern feng and western sacrifice, imperial carriage bells sound; following in favor, witnessing ascendant peace.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern feng and western sacrifice—the imperial carriage bells sound; following in favor, one witnesses ascendant peace.

sentences.zh: 仙遊一去上三清，廟食享隆名。

translations.literal: Immortal journey once departed to the Three Purities; temple sacrifice enjoys illustrious name.
translations.idiomatic: Her immortal journey once departed to the Three Purities; temple sacrifice enjoys an illustrious name.

sentences.zh: 寢園松柏秋風起，簫吹想平生。

translations.literal: Mausoleum garden pines and cypresses, autumn wind rises; xiao playing recalls a lifetime.
translations.idiomatic: In the mausoleum garden pines and cypresses stir in the autumn wind; xiao playing recalls a lifetime.

sentences.zh: △中太一宮奉安神像《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Zhongtaiyi Palace reverent installation of spirit image, Guiding Procession, one piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Zhongtaiyi Palace reverent installation of the spirit image—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 九霄仙馭，四紀樂西清，遊衍遍黃庭。

translations.literal: Nine heavens' immortal carriage; four eras rejoiced in Western Clarity; wandering far through the Yellow Court.
translations.idiomatic: Nine heavens' immortal carriage—for four eras rejoicing in Western Clarity, wandering far through the Yellow Court.

sentences.zh: 雲駢萬里歸真室，上應泰階平。

translations.literal: Cloud team ten thousand li returns to the truth hall; above responding, the Grand Terrace is level.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud teams ten thousand li return to the truth hall; above, the Grand Terrace responds in level harmony.

sentences.zh: 金輿玉像下瑤京，彩仗擁霓旌。

translations.literal: Golden carriage, jade image descend from Jade Capital; colored halberds surround rainbow banners.
translations.idiomatic: Golden carriage and jade image descend from the Jade Capital; colored halberds surround rainbow banners.

sentences.zh: 天人感會千年運，福祚永昌明。

translations.literal: Heaven and humanity meet in responsive harmony; thousand-year fortune, blessing eternally bright and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and humanity meet in responsive harmony; the thousand-year fortune brings blessing eternally bright and clear.

sentences.zh: △四年英宗御容赴景靈宮奉安《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Fourth year, Yingzong imperial portrait journey to Jingling Palace for reverent installation, Guiding Procession, one piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Fourth year: Yingzong's imperial portrait journey to Jingling Palace for reverent installation—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 鼎湖龍去，仙仗隔蓬萊，輦路已蒼苔。

translations.literal: Ding Lake dragon gone; immortal halberds separated by Penglai; carriage road already green with moss.
translations.idiomatic: The Ding Lake dragon is gone; immortal halberds stand separated by Penglai; the carriage road is already green with moss.

sentences.zh: 漢家原廟臨清渭，還泣玉衣來。

translations.literal: Han dynasty's original temple faces clear Wei River; still weeping, jade garment returns.
translations.idiomatic: The Han dynasty's original temple faces the clear Wei River; still weeping, the jade garment returns.

sentences.zh: 鳳簫鸞扇共徘徊，帳殿倚雲開。

translations.literal: Phoenix xiao, luan fans together wander; tent hall leans on clouds and opens.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix xiao and luan fans wander together; the tent hall leans on clouds and opens.

sentences.zh: 春風不向天袍動，空繞翠輿回。

translations.literal: Spring wind does not stir the heavenly robe; empty, it circles the emerald carriage returning.
translations.idiomatic: Spring wind does not stir the heavenly robe; empty, it circles the emerald carriage returning.

sentences.zh: △十年南郊皇帝歸青城《降仙台》一首

translations.literal: △ Tenth year, Southern Suburb, emperor returns to Qingcheng, Descent of the Immortal Terrace, one piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Tenth year, Southern Suburb: the emperor returns to Qingcheng—one Descent of the Immortal Terrace piece

sentences.zh: 《降仙台》

translations.literal: Descent of the Immortal Terrace
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Immortal Terrace

sentences.zh: 清都未曉，萬乘並駕，煌煌擁天行。

translations.literal: Pure capital not yet dawn; ten thousand chariots ride abreast, blazing bright embracing heaven as they move.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn in the pure capital, ten thousand chariots ride abreast, blazing bright as they advance beneath heaven.

sentences.zh: 祥風散瑞靄，華蓋聳旂常，建耀層城。

translations.literal: Auspicious wind scatters auspicious mist; floral canopy towers with banner-constants, blazing radiance over the layered city.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious winds scatter auspicious mist; the floral canopy towers with banner-constants, blazing radiance over the layered city.

translations.literal: Four ranks of guard soldiers; torch-fire reflects golden branches and emerald-green banners.
translations.idiomatic: Four ranks of guard soldiers; torch-fire gleams on golden branches and emerald-green banners.

sentences.zh: 眾樂警作充宮庭，繹成。

translations.literal: All music sounds the vigil alert, filling the palace court; the sequence complete.
translations.idiomatic: All music sounds the vigil alert, filling the palace court—the sequence complete.

sentences.zh: 紺幄掀，袞冕明。

translations.literal: Dark-blue canopy lifted; robes and crown shine bright.
translations.idiomatic: The dark-blue canopy is raised; robes and crown shine bright.

sentences.zh: 妥帖壇陛，霄升振珩璜，神格至誠。

translations.literal: Properly placed at altar steps; ascending heavenward, jade pendants ring—spirits attend to utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Properly placed at the altar steps, ascending heavenward as jade pendants ring—the spirits attend to utmost sincerity.

sentences.zh: 雲車下冥冥，儲祥降嘏莫可名。

translations.literal: Cloud chariots descend into the deep dark; stored blessing and descended felicitations beyond naming.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud chariots descend into the deep dark; stored blessings and descended felicitations beyond all naming.

sentences.zh: 禦端闕，朌號敷榮。

translations.literal: Facing the Gate of Propriety; the proclaimed title spreads in glory.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the Gate of Propriety, the proclaimed title spreads in glory.

sentences.zh: 澤翔施溥，茂祉均被含生。

translations.literal: Favor soars far and spreads broad; abundant blessing equally reaches all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Favor soars far and spreads broad; abundant blessing reaches all living beings alike.

sentences.zh: △元豐二年慈聖光獻皇后發引四首儀仗內《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Yuanfeng second year, Empress Dowager Cisheng Guangxian funeral procession, four pieces: one Guiding Procession within the guard of honor
translations.idiomatic: △ Yuanfeng second year [1079]: Empress Dowager Cisheng Guangxian's funeral procession, four pieces—one Guiding Procession within the guard of honor

sentences.zh: 駕斑龍，忽催金母，轉仙仗，去瑤宮。

translations.literal: Driving the dappled dragon; suddenly the Golden Mother is summoned; turning the immortal guard, leaving the Jade Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Driving the dappled dragon, suddenly the Golden Mother is summoned; the immortal guard turns away, leaving the Jade Palace.

sentences.zh: 絳闕深沉杳無蹤，漸塵空。

translations.literal: Crimson gate deep and remote—no trace remains; gradually all turns to empty dust.
translations.idiomatic: The crimson gate lies deep and remote—no trace remains; gradually all turns to empty dust.

sentences.zh: 絲網瓊林，花似怨東風，垂清露啼紅。

translations.literal: Silken nets in the jade forest; flowers seem to resent the east wind, hanging clear dew, weeping crimson.
translations.idiomatic: Silken nets in the jade forest; flowers seem to resent the east wind, hanging clear dew and weeping crimson.

sentences.zh: 猶想舊春中，獻萬壽，寶船空。

translations.literal: Still one recalls the old springtime; offering long life—the treasure boat empty.
translations.idiomatic: Still one recalls the old springtime, offering wishes for long life—now the treasure boat is empty.

sentences.zh: 警場內三曲

translations.literal: Three pieces within the watch ground
translations.idiomatic: Three pieces within the watch ground

sentences.zh: 《六州》

translations.literal: Six Prefectures
translations.idiomatic: Six Prefectures

sentences.zh: 九龍輿，記春暮，幸蓬壺。

translations.literal: Nine dragon chariots—I recall late spring; favored with a visit to Penglai's abode.
translations.idiomatic: Nine dragon chariots—I recall late spring, favored with a visit to Penglai's abode.

sentences.zh: 瓊囿敞，繡仗趨，年華與逝水俱。

translations.literal: Jade garden opens wide; embroidered halberds hurry on; years and flowing water depart together.
translations.idiomatic: The jade garden stands open; embroidered halberds hurry onward; the years depart with the flowing water.

sentences.zh: 瑤京遠，信息斷無。

translations.literal: Jade Capital far away; word comes no more.
translations.idiomatic: The Jade Capital is far away; no word comes anymore.

sentences.zh: 寶津池麵落花鋪，愁晚容車來禁途。

translations.literal: Baojin Pool's surface, fallen flowers spread; grieving, the late bier comes on the forbidden road.
translations.idiomatic: On the Baojin Pool's surface fallen flowers spread; grieving, the late bier comes along the forbidden road.

sentences.zh: 鳳簫鑾翣，西指昭陵去。

translations.literal: Phoenix xiao and luan fans—westward, toward Zhaoling they go.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix xiao and luan fans—westward they go, toward Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 舊賞蟠桃熟，又見漲海枯。

translations.literal: Old delight: flat peaches ripened; again I see the swelling sea dry up.
translations.idiomatic: The old delight of ripened flat peaches—again I see the swelling sea run dry.

sentences.zh: 應共靈真母，曳霞裾。

translations.literal: Surely she joins the Spirit True Mother, trailing rainbow skirts.
translations.idiomatic: Surely she joins the Spirit True Mother, trailing rainbow skirts.

sentences.zh: 宴清都，恨滿山隅，春城翠柏藏烏。

translations.literal: Feast in the pure capital; regret fills the mountain corners; spring city with green cypresses hiding the crows.
translations.idiomatic: A feast in the pure capital—regret fills the mountain corners; green cypresses in the spring city hide the crows.

sentences.zh: 扃戶劍，照燈魚，人間一夢覺餘。

translations.literal: Bolted gate and sword; lamp-lit fish—the human world, a dream's awakening residue.
translations.idiomatic: Bolted gate and sword, lamp-lit fish—the human world, the residue of a dream's awakening.

sentences.zh: 泉宮窈窕鎖夜龍，銀江澄澹浴仙鳧，煙冷金爐玉殿虛。

translations.literal: Spring palace elegant and locked, night dragons within; silver river clear and calm bathes immortal ducks; cold smoke, cold golden censer—jade halls empty.
translations.idiomatic: The spring palace stands elegant, locked with night dragons within; the silver river runs clear and calm, bathing immortal ducks; cold smoke rises from the cold golden censer—the jade halls stand empty.

sentences.zh: 綠苔新長，雕輦曾行處。

translations.literal: Fresh green moss grows where the carved carriage once passed.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh green moss grows where the carved carriage once passed.

sentences.zh: 夜夜東朝月，似舊照錦疏，侍女盈盈淚珠。

translations.literal: Night after night the Eastern Court moon, as of old shining on embroidered screens—handmaids with brimming tears.
translations.idiomatic: Night after night the Eastern Court moon shines, as of old on the embroidered screens—handmaids with brimming tears.

sentences.zh: 《十二時》

translations.literal: Twelve Hours
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Hours

sentences.zh: 治平時，暫垂簾，佑聖子，解危疑。

translations.literal: In the Zhiping era, temporarily holding the curtain behind the throne, aiding the sage son, resolving peril and doubt.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiping era [1064–1067], she temporarily held the curtain behind the throne, aiding the sage son and resolving peril and doubt.

sentences.zh: 坐安天下，逾歲厭避萬機，退處宸闈。

translations.literal: She sat securing the realm under heaven; year upon year she wearied of and avoided myriad affairs of state, retiring to the imperial inner quarters.
translations.idiomatic: She secured the realm under heaven; year upon year she wearied of the myriad affairs of state and retired to the imperial inner quarters.

sentences.zh: 殿開慶，養誌入希夷。

translations.literal: Hall of Celebration opened; nurturing aspiration entered the realm of stillness.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Celebration opened; nurturing aspiration she entered the realm of stillness.

sentences.zh: 扶皓日，浴鹹池。

translations.literal: Supporting the bright sun; bathing in the Salty Pool.
translations.idiomatic: Supporting the bright sun; bathing in the Salty Pool.

sentences.zh: 看神孫撫禦，千載重雍累熙，四方欽仰洪慈。

translations.literal: Watching the divine grandson hold the reins—for a thousand years again abundant and ever more flourishing; the four quarters revere and look up to vast kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Watching the divine grandson hold the reins—for a thousand years again abundant and ever more flourishing; the four quarters revere and look up to vast kindness.

sentences.zh: 陰德遠，仁功積，歡養罄九域，禮無違。

translations.literal: Hidden virtue far-reaching, benevolent merit accumulated; joyfully nurturing exhausted the nine domains—rites without breach.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden virtue far-reaching, benevolent merit accumulated; joyfully nurturing exhausted the nine domains; rites without breach.

sentences.zh: 事難期，乘霞去，乍睹升仙，誥下九圍。

translations.literal: Matters hard to foretell—riding mist she departs; suddenly beholding ascension to immortality; edicts descend through the nine domains.
translations.idiomatic: Matters hard to foretell—riding mist she departs; suddenly one beholds ascension to immortality; edicts descend through the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 泣血漣如，更鸞車動，春晚霧暗翠旂，路指嵩、伊。

translations.literal: Weeping blood in streams; again the luan carriage moves; late spring, mist darkens the emerald banners; the road points toward Song and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Weeping blood in streams; again the luan carriage moves; late spring, mist darkens the emerald banners; the road points toward Song and Yi.

sentences.zh: 薤歌鳳吹，悠颺逐風悲。

translations.literal: Leek song and phoenix blow—far and wafting, chasing the wind in grief.
translations.idiomatic: The leek song and phoenix blow—far and wafting, chasing the wind in grief.

sentences.zh: 珠殿悄，綱塵垂。

translations.literal: Pearl halls silent; gauze dust hangs down.
translations.idiomatic: Pearl halls stand silent; gauze dust hangs down.

sentences.zh: 空坐濕。

translations.literal: Empty seats wet.
translations.idiomatic: Empty seats wet with tears.

sentences.zh: 罔極吾皇孝思，鏤玉寫音徽。

translations.literal: Boundless is our emperor's filial thought; engraved jade inscribes her fine reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Boundless is our emperor's filial thought; engraved jade inscribes her fine reputation.

sentences.zh: 彤管煒，青編紀，寧更羨周《雅》播聲詩。

translations.literal: Red brush brilliant; green records commemorate—how much more would one envy the Zhou Odes spreading their sound-poems!
translations.idiomatic: The red brush shines brilliant; green records commemorate—how much more would one envy the Zhou Odes spreading their sound-poems!
