translations.literal: Mausoleum-gazers disperse; emerald cypresses suddenly form rows.
translations.idiomatic: Those gazing at the mausoleum disperse—emerald cypresses suddenly stand in rows.

sentences.zh: 獨餘嵩峰月，夜夜照幽堂，千秋陳跡淒涼。

translations.literal: Alone remaining Mount Song's moon; night after night shining on secluded hall; thousand autumns old traces desolate.
translations.idiomatic: Only Mount Song's moon remains—night after night shining on the secluded hall; through a thousand autumns the old traces lie desolate.

sentences.zh: 《十二時》

translations.literal: Twelve Hours
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Hours

sentences.zh: 珍符錫，佑啟真人，儲思在斯民。

translations.literal: Precious talismans bestowed; protect and open the true person; store thoughts in these people.
translations.idiomatic: Precious talismans bestowed, protecting and opening the true sovereign—his stored thoughts were with these people.

sentences.zh: 勤勞日升，萬物皆入陶鈞。

translations.literal: Toil and labor daily rise; all things enter the potter's wheel.
translations.idiomatic: Toil and labor rose daily; all things were placed on the potter's wheel.

sentences.zh: 收威柄，更法令，鼎從新。

translations.literal: Gather authority; renew laws and decrees; tripod from new.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering authority, renewing laws and decrees—the tripod anew.

sentences.zh: 東風吹百卉，上苑正青春。

translations.literal: East wind blows a hundred plants; upper garden just in spring youth.
translations.idiomatic: East wind blows over a hundred plants—the upper garden in fresh spring youth.

sentences.zh: 流虹節近，衣冠玉帛，交奏嚴宸，萬壽祝堯仁。

translations.literal: Rainbow-flowing festival near; robes and caps, jade and silk; interplaying performances at solemn palace; ten thousand years wishing Emperor Yao's benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The Rainbow-flowing Festival draws near—robes and caps, jade and silk, interplaying performances at the solemn palace, wishing ten thousand years of Emperor Yao's benevolence.

sentences.zh: 忽聽宮車晚出，但號慕，瞻雲路，企龍鱗。

translations.literal: Suddenly hear palace carriage late departing; only wail in longing, gaze at cloud road, long for dragon scales.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly comes word the palace carriage departs late in the day—only wailing in longing, gazing at the cloud road, longing for the dragon's scales.

sentences.zh: 窮天英冠古精神。

translations.literal: Exhausting heaven's brilliance, crowning antiquity in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausting heaven's brilliance, crowning antiquity in spirit.

sentences.zh: 杳然上傃，人空望屬車巡。

translations.literal: Distantly ascending heaven; people in vain watch the following carriages circling.
translations.idiomatic: He has ascended heaven into the distance—people in vain watch the following carriages circling.

sentences.zh: 虛仗星陳，畫翣環擁龍盾。

translations.literal: Empty guard arrayed like stars; painted fans encircle embracing dragon shields.
translations.idiomatic: The empty guard arrayed like stars; painted fans encircling, embracing the dragon shields.

sentences.zh: 泉宮掩，帝鄉遠，邈難親。

translations.literal: Spring palace closed; emperor's homeland far—distant, hard to draw near.
translations.idiomatic: The spring palace is sealed; the emperor's homeland far—distant and hard to draw near.

sentences.zh: 反周輪，飛羽蓋，還渡天津。

translations.literal: Return the Zhou carriage wheels; flying feather canopy; again cross Heavenly Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Returning the Zhou carriage wheels, flying feather canopy—again crossing the Heavenly Ford.

sentences.zh: 霧迷朱服，風搖細扇，觸目悲辛。

translations.literal: Mist obscures vermilion robes; wind sways fine fans—each sight grief and bitter sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: Mist obscures vermilion robes; wind sways fine fans—every sight brings grief and bitter sorrow.

sentences.zh: 列嬪嬙，垂紅淚，浥行塵。

translations.literal: Ranks of concubines; hang red tears, dampening road dust.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks of concubines hang red tears, dampening the road dust.

sentences.zh: 相將問，何日下青旻？

translations.literal: Accompanying each other they ask—what day will descend from the azure heavens?
translations.idiomatic: Walking together they ask—on what day will he descend from the azure heavens?

sentences.zh: 《永裕陵歌》

translations.literal: Yongyu Mausoleum Song
translations.idiomatic: Yongyu Mausoleum Song

sentences.zh: 升龍德，當位富春秋。

translations.literal: Ascending dragon virtue; taking the throne, rich in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending in dragon virtue, taking the throne rich in years.

sentences.zh: 受天球，膺駿命，玉帛走諸侯。

translations.literal: Receive the heavenly sphere; receive splendid mandate; jade and silk rush to feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the heavenly sphere, accepting the splendid mandate—jade and silk sent envoys rushing to the feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 寶閣珠樓臨上苑，百卉弄春柔。

translations.literal: Treasure pavilions and pearl towers overlooking upper garden; a hundred plants play in spring softness.
translations.idiomatic: Treasure pavilions and pearl towers overlook the upper garden—a hundred plants play in spring's softness.

sentences.zh: 隱約瀛洲，旦旦想宸遊。

translations.literal: Dimly visible Yingzhou; daily daily longing for imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou dimly visible—day after day longing for the imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 那知羽駕忽難留，八馬入丹丘，哀仗出神州。

translations.literal: Who knew feathered carriage suddenly hard to retain; eight horses enter Crimson Hill; mourning guard departs divine land.
translations.idiomatic: Who could have known the feathered carriage would suddenly be impossible to keep—the eight horses entering Crimson Hill, the mourning guard departing the divine land.

sentences.zh: 笳聲凝咽，旌旂去悠悠。

translations.literal: Horn sound choked and stifled; banners and flags depart far and lingering.
translations.idiomatic: Horn sounds choke and stifle; banners and flags depart far and lingering.

sentences.zh: 碧山頭，真人地，龜洛奧，鳳台幽。

translations.literal: Green mountain summits; true person's earth; Tortoise-Luo depths; Phoenix Terrace gloom.
translations.idiomatic: Green mountain summits—the true one's earth; Tortoise-Luo's depths, Phoenix Terrace's gloom.

sentences.zh: 繞伊流，嵩峰岡勢結蛟虯。

translations.literal: Winding the Yi River; Mount Song peak ridges' momentum knots hornless dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Winding around the Yi River—Mount Song's ridge-lines knot like hornless dragons.

sentences.zh: 皇堂一閉威顏杳，寒霧帶天愁。

translations.literal: Imperial hall once closed, august countenance far away; cold mist carries heaven's grief.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial hall once closed—the august countenance far away; cold mist carries heaven's grief.

sentences.zh: 守陵嬪禦，想像奉龍輈。

translations.literal: Mausoleum-guarding concubines and attendants; imagining serving the dragon carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Mausoleum-guarding concubines and attendants—imagining serving the dragon carriage.

sentences.zh: 牙盤赭案肅神休，何日覿雲裘！

translations.literal: Ivory trays and red tables, solemn spirit rest—what day will we see the cloud robes!
translations.idiomatic: Ivory trays and red tables solemnly lay the spirit to rest—on what day will we see the cloud robes again!

sentences.zh: 紅淚滴衣褠，那堪風點綴柏城秋。

translations.literal: Red tears drip on robe hems; how can one bear wind adorning cypress-city autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Red tears drip on robe hems—how can one bear the wind adorning cypress-city in autumn.

sentences.zh: △虞主回京四首《導引》

translations.literal: △ Escort Master returns to the capital, four pieces—Guiding Procession
translations.idiomatic: △ Escort Master returns to the capital, four pieces—Guiding Procession

sentences.zh: 上林寒早，仙仗轉郊圻，笳鼓入雲悲。

translations.literal: Upper forest cold early; immortal guard turns at suburban district; horns and drums enter clouds mournful.
translations.idiomatic: Early cold in the Upper Forest—the immortal guard turns at the suburban district; horns and drums rise into the clouds in grief.

sentences.zh: 逶迤輦路過西池，樓閣鎖參差。

translations.literal: Winding carriage road passes West Pool; tower pavilions locked irregularly.
translations.idiomatic: The winding carriage road passes West Pool—tower pavilions locked in uneven ranks.

sentences.zh: 都人瞻望意如疑，猶想翠華歸。

translations.literal: Capital people gazing expectantly as if doubting—still thinking emerald splendor returns.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's people gaze up in doubt—still thinking the emerald splendor will return.

sentences.zh: 玉京傳信杳無期，空掩赭黃衣。

translations.literal: Jade Capital word comes without term; empty cover ochre-yellow robes.
translations.idiomatic: Word from the Jade Capital comes without appointed time—in vain covering the ochre-yellow robes.

sentences.zh: 《六州》

translations.literal: Six Prefectures
translations.idiomatic: Six Prefectures

sentences.zh: 承聖緒，垂意在升平。

translations.literal: Inherit sage succession; let intention rest in ascending peace.
translations.idiomatic: Inheriting the sage succession, his intention rested on ascending peace.

sentences.zh: 驅貔虎，策豪英，號令肅天兵。

translations.literal: Drive bears and tigers; spur heroic elites; orders and commands solemn heavenly troops.
translations.idiomatic: Driving bears and tigers, spurring heroic elites—orders and commands solemn over heaven's troops.

sentences.zh: 四方無復羽書征，德澤浸群生。

translations.literal: Four directions no more feather-dispatch military campaigns; virtue's grace saturates all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: The four directions saw no more dispatch of military campaigns—virtue's grace saturated all living beings.

sentences.zh: 睿謀雄雋，絀漢高狹陋，慕三皇二帝登閎，緝樂綴文明。

translations.literal: Wise plans heroic and outstanding; surpass Han Gaozu's narrow and crude; admire Three Sovereigns and Two Emperors ascending the broad; compile music, link civilization.
translations.idiomatic: Wise plans heroic and outstanding—surpassing Han Gaozu's narrowness, admiring the Three Sovereigns and Two Emperors ascending the broad, compiling music and linking civilization.

sentences.zh: 將升岱嶽告功成，玉牒金繩，勝寶飛聲。

translations.literal: About to ascend Mount Tai announcing achievement complete; jade tablets and golden cords; surpassing treasure, flying fame.
translations.idiomatic: About to ascend Mount Tai to announce achievement complete—jade tablets and golden cords, surpassing treasure and flying fame.

sentences.zh: 事難評。

translations.literal: Matters hard to judge.
translations.idiomatic: Matters hard to judge.

sentences.zh: 軒鼎就，清都一夢俄頃。

translations.literal: Chariot and cauldron done; pure capital one dream in a moment.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot and cauldron done—the pure capital a dream in a moment.

sentences.zh: 飛霞佩，乘龍馭，羽衛入高清。

translations.literal: Flying cloud pendants; ride dragon reins; feather guards enter high clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Flying cloud pendants, riding dragon reins—the feather guards enter high clarity.

sentences.zh: 祥光浮動五色，迎鸞鳳，雜簫笙。

translations.literal: Auspicious light floats moving five colors; welcome phoenixes; mixed xiao and sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light floats in five colors—welcoming phoenixes, mixed with xiao and sheng.

sentences.zh: 因山功就，同軌人至，銘旌畫翣，行背重城。

translations.literal: Following mountain achievement done; same-track people arrive; inscribed banners painted fans; procession backs away from layered city.
translations.idiomatic: Following mountain achievement complete, people of the realm arrive—inscribed banners and painted fans, the procession turning away from the layered city.

sentences.zh: 楚笳凝咽，漢儀雄盛，攀慕傷情。

translations.literal: Chu horns choke and stifle; Han rites heroic and grand; clinging longing wounds feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Chu horns choke and stifle; Han rites heroic and grand—clinging longing wounds the heart.

sentences.zh: 惟餘內傳，知向蓬、瀛。

translations.literal: Only remaining inner transmission; know toward Penglai and Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Only the inner transmission remains—knowing the way toward Penglai and Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 《十二時》

translations.literal: Twelve Hours
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Hours

sentences.zh: 太平時，禦華夷。

translations.literal: Peaceful times; govern Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: In peaceful times, governing Chinese and barbarians alike.

sentences.zh: 躬聽斷，破危疑。

translations.literal: Personally hear and decide; break peril and doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Personally hearing and deciding, breaking through peril and doubt.

sentences.zh: 春秋鼎盛，絀聲樂遊嬉，日升繁機。

translations.literal: Spring and autumn at peak; surpass sound and music in travel and play; daily rise in complex affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the prime of years, surpassing sound and music in travel and play—daily rise in complex affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 長駕遠馭，垂意在軒、羲。

translations.literal: Long drive, distant control; let intention rest in Xuan and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Long drive, distant control—intention resting on the sages Xuanyuan and Fuxi.

sentences.zh: 恢六典，斥三垂。

translations.literal: Restore six canons; repel three frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring the six canons, repelling the three frontiers.

sentences.zh: 有殊尤絕跡，盛德旁魄周施，方將綴緝聲詩。

translations.literal: Have extraordinary ultimate outstanding traces; grand virtue vast and circling broad application; just about to compile and link sound and poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Having extraordinary and unmatched traces—grand virtue vast and widely applied, just about to compile and link sound and poetry.

sentences.zh: 擴皇綱，明帝典，紹累聖重熙，高拱無為，事難知。

translations.literal: Expand imperial net; clarify emperor's canon; continue successive sages' repeated brilliance; high arching non-action; matters hard to know.
translations.idiomatic: Expanding the imperial net, clarifying the emperor's canon, continuing successive sages' repeated brilliance—high arching in non-action, matters hard to know.

sentences.zh: 春色盛，逼千秋嘉節，忽聞憑玉幾，頒命彤闈，厭世禦雲歸。

translations.literal: Spring colors flourish; approaching thousand-autumn auspicious festival; suddenly hear leaning on jade armrest, issuing mandate at red gate; weary of world riding clouds returns.
translations.idiomatic: Spring colors flourish, approaching the thousand-autumn auspicious festival—suddenly word comes of leaning on the jade armrest, issuing mandate at the red gate; weary of the world, riding clouds he returns.

sentences.zh: 翊翠鳳，駕文螭，縹緲難追。

translations.literal: Assist emerald phoenix; drive patterned hornless dragons; ethereal hard to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting the emerald phoenix, driving patterned hornless dragons—ethereal and impossible to pursue.

sentences.zh: 侍臣宮女，但攀慕號悲。

translations.literal: Attending ministers and palace women; only cling in longing, wail in grief.
translations.idiomatic: Attending ministers and palace women—only clinging in longing, wailing in grief.

sentences.zh: 玉輪動，指嵩、伊。

translations.literal: Jade wheels move; pointing Mount Song and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The jade wheels move—pointing toward Mount Song and the Yi.

sentences.zh: 龍鑣日益遠，空遊漢廟冠衣。

translations.literal: Dragon bridle daily more distant; empty tour of Han temple robes and caps.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon bridle daily more distant—empty tour of Han temple robes and caps.

sentences.zh: 惟盛德巍巍，鏤玉冊，傳青史，昭示無期。

translations.literal: Only grand virtue towering and lofty; carve jade book; transmit green history; proclaim and show without end.
translations.idiomatic: Only the towering grand virtue—carving jade books, transmitting to green history, proclaimed and shown without end.

sentences.zh: 《虞神》

translations.literal: Spirit-Receiving Ceremony
translations.idiomatic: Spirit-Receiving Ceremony

sentences.zh: 復土初，明旌下儲胥。

translations.literal: Return earth at first; bright banners descend to attendants.
translations.idiomatic: At the first return of earth, bright banners descend to the attendants.

sentences.zh: 回虛仗，簫笳互奏，旌旆隨驅。

translations.literal: Return empty guard; xiao and horns interplaying; banners and flags follow driving.
translations.idiomatic: The empty guard returns—xiao and horns interplaying, banners and flags following the procession.

sentences.zh: 豈知飆禦在蓬壺，道縈紆。

translations.literal: Who knew wind-carriage in Penglai's abode; road winding curved.
translations.idiomatic: Who could have known the wind-carriage is in Penglai's abode—the road winding on.

sentences.zh: 風日慘，六馬躊躇，留恨滿山隅。

translations.literal: Wind and sun bleak; six horses hesitate and linger; lingering regret fills the mountain corner.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and sun bleak—the six horses hesitate and linger; lingering regret fills the mountain corner.

sentences.zh: 不堪回首，翠柏已扶疏。

translations.literal: Cannot bear to turn head and look back; emerald cypresses already luxuriant and sparse.
translations.idiomatic: Cannot bear to look back—emerald cypresses already stand lush and sparse.

sentences.zh: 帝城漸邇。

translations.literal: Imperial city gradually draws near.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial city gradually draws near.

sentences.zh: 愁霧鎖天衢。

translations.literal: Grief-mist locks the heavenly thoroughfare.
translations.idiomatic: Grief-mist locks the heavenly thoroughfare.

sentences.zh: 公卿百辟，鱗集雲敷，迓龍輿。

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, and all officials—like fish scales gathering, like clouds spreading—welcome the dragon carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes, ministers, and all officials gather like fish scales, spread like clouds—welcoming the dragon carriage.

sentences.zh: 端門辟，金碧淩虛，此時還帝都。

translations.literal: Meridian Gate opens; gold and azure tower above the void—at this moment returning to the imperial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Meridian Gate opens, gold and azure soaring above the void—at this moment returning to the imperial capital.

sentences.zh: 嚴清廟，入空畤，升文物，燦爛極嘉娛。

translations.literal: Solemnly at the Pure Temple, enter the Empty Altar, ascend cultural objects—blazing brilliance reaching utmost splendid joy.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly at the Pure Temple, entering the Empty Altar, ascending cultural treasures—blazing brilliance in utmost splendid joy.

sentences.zh: 配三宗，號稱神古所無。

translations.literal: Paired with Three Ancestors; title and acclaim—divine, unknown since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Paired with the Three Ancestors—a title acclaimed as divine, unknown since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 帝德協唐、虞，《九歌》畢奏斐然殊，會軒朱。

translations.literal: Emperor's virtue harmonizes with Tang and Yu; Nine Songs completely performed, splendid and distinct; meeting the vermilion pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's virtue harmonizes with Tang and Yu—the Nine Songs fully performed, splendid and distinctive, meeting at the vermilion pavilion.

sentences.zh: 神具燕喜，錫福集皇居。

translations.literal: Spirits all partake in banquet joy; bestowed blessings gather at the imperial residence.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits all partake in banquet joy—blessings bestowed gather at the imperial residence.

sentences.zh: 更千萬祀，佑啟邦圖。

translations.literal: For yet ten thousand myriad sacrifices, protect and open the realm's design.
translations.idiomatic: For yet ten thousand myriad sacrifices—protect and open the realm's design.

sentences.zh: △神主祔廟一首《導引》

translations.literal: △ Spirit tablet enshrined at ancestral temple, one piece—Guiding Procession
translations.idiomatic: △ Spirit tablet enshrined at the ancestral temple—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 歲華婉娩，侍宴玉皇宮，周輦出房中。

translations.literal: Years and seasons gentle and fair; attend banquet at Jade Emperor Palace; the imperial Zhou carriage emerges from the inner chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Years and seasons gentle and fair—attending the banquet at Jade Emperor Palace, the imperial Zhou carriage emerges from the inner chamber.

sentences.zh: 豈知軒後丹成去，望絕鼎湖龍。

translations.literal: Who knew Yellow Emperor after cinnabar elixir complete would depart; hope cut off at Ding Lake's dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Who could have known the Yellow Emperor, once the cinnabar elixir was complete, would depart—the dragon of Ding Lake forever beyond reach.

sentences.zh: 壽原初掩九虞終，歸蹕五雲重。

translations.literal: Longevity mound first covered, nine lamentations complete; return the imperial procession, five clouds heavy.
translations.idiomatic: The longevity mound first covered, the nine lamentations complete—the imperial procession returns beneath heavy five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 惟餘寶冊書鴻烈，清廟配三宗。

translations.literal: Only remaining precious book records grand achievements; Pure Temple paired with Three Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Only the precious book recording grand achievements remains—the Pure Temple paired with the Three Ancestors.

sentences.zh: △政和三年追冊明達皇后《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Third year of Zhenghe posthumous enshrinement of Empress Mingda—one Guiding Procession piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Third year of Zhenghe [1113]: posthumous enshrinement of Empress Mingda—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 來嬪初載，令德冠層城，柔範藹徽聲。

translations.literal: Coming as consort at first years; fine virtue crowns the layered city; gentle model radiates fine reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Coming as consort in her first years—fine virtue crowned the layered city, her gentle model radiating fine reputation.

sentences.zh: 熊羆夢應芳蘭鬱，佳氣擁雕楹。

translations.literal: Bear-and-tiger dream answered; fragrant orchids lush; auspicious qi embraces carved pillars.
translations.idiomatic: The bear-and-tiger dream answered, fragrant orchids lush—auspicious qi embraced the carved pillars.

sentences.zh: 珠宮縹緲泛蓬、瀛，脫屣世緣輕。

translations.literal: Pearl palace ethereal drifting on Penglai and Yingzhou; shed shoes, worldly ties light.
translations.idiomatic: The pearl palace drifts ethereally on Penglai and Yingzhou—shedding worldly ties as lightly as cast-off shoes.

sentences.zh: 空餘寶冊光瓊玖，千古仰鴻名。

translations.literal: Empty remaining precious book shines like fine jade; through a thousand ages people look up to grand fame.
translations.idiomatic: Only the precious book shines like fine jade—through a thousand ages people look up to her grand fame.

sentences.zh: △神主祔別廟《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Spirit tablet enshrined at separate temple—one Guiding Procession piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Spirit tablet enshrined at the separate temple—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 柔容懿範，蚤歲藹層闈，蘭夢結芳時。

translations.literal: Gentle countenance, virtuous model; early years radiant in layered inner gates; orchid dream knots at fragrant season.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle countenance and virtuous model—in early years radiant within the layered inner gates, an orchid dream knotted at a fragrant season.

sentences.zh: 秋風一夜驚羅幕。

translations.literal: Autumn wind one night startles the gauze curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn wind one night startles the gauze curtain.

sentences.zh: 鸞扇影空回。

translations.literal: Phoenix-fan shadow empty returns.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix-fan shadow returns in vain.

sentences.zh: 榮追禕翟盛威儀，遺像掩瑤扉。

translations.literal: Honor posthumously pursued with ceremonial robes and grand majesty; portrait covered, jade doors shut.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors pursued with ceremonial robes and grand majesty—the portrait covered, the jade doors shut.

sentences.zh: 春來隻有芭蕉葉，依舊倚晴暉。

translations.literal: Spring comes with only banana leaves—still leaning in clear sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: When spring comes only banana leaves remain—still leaning in the clear sunlight.

sentences.zh: △景靈西宮坤元殿奉安欽成皇后御容《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Jingling Western Palace Kunyuan Hall installation of Empress Qincheng's imperial portrait—one Guiding Procession piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Installing Empress Qincheng's imperial portrait at Kunyuan Hall, Jingling Western Palace—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 雲軿芝蓋，仙路去難攀，海浪濺三山。

translations.literal: Cloud carriage and ganoderma canopy; immortal road departs, hard to climb; sea waves splash the three mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud carriage and ganoderma canopy—the immortal road departs, impossible to climb; sea waves splash the three mountains.

sentences.zh: 重迎遺像臨馳道，還似在人間。

translations.literal: Again welcoming the portrait by the imperial thoroughfare—still seems as in the human world.
translations.idiomatic: Again welcoming the portrait beside the imperial thoroughfare—it still seems as in the human world.

sentences.zh: 西宮瑤殿指坤元，璿榜聳飛鸞。

translations.literal: Western Palace jade hall points to Kunyuan; jade placard towers, flying phoenixes.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Palace's jade hall points to Kunyuan—the jade placard towers, phoenixes flying.

sentences.zh: 移升寶殿從新詔，盛典永流傳。

translations.literal: Moved and elevated to treasure hall according to new decree; grand ceremony forever transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Moved and elevated to the treasure hall according to the new decree—a grand ceremony to be forever transmitted.

sentences.zh: △別廟《導引》一首

translations.literal: △ Separate temple—one Guiding Procession piece
translations.idiomatic: △ Separate temple—one Guiding Procession piece

sentences.zh: 蓬萊邃館，金碧照三山，真境勝人間。

translations.literal: Penglai's deep pavilion; gold and azure shine on three mountains; true realm surpasses human world.
translations.idiomatic: Penglai's deep pavilion—gold and azure shining on the three mountains—a true realm surpassing the human world.

sentences.zh: 秋風又見芭蕉長，遺跡在人寰。

translations.literal: Autumn wind again sees banana plants long; traces remain in human realm.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn wind again sees banana plants grown long—traces remaining in the human realm.

sentences.zh: 雲軒一去杳難攀，斑竹彩輿還。

translations.literal: Cloud pavilion once gone, far and hard to climb; mottled bamboo and colored carriage return.
translations.idiomatic: The cloud pavilion once gone, far and impossible to reach—the mottled bamboo and colored carriage return.

sentences.zh: 深宮舊監聞簫鼓，悵望慘朱顏。

translations.literal: Deep palace old attendants hear xiao and drums; gazing in longing, wan vermilion faces.
translations.idiomatic: Deep palace old attendants hear xiao and drums—gazing in longing with wan vermilion faces.
